Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the product demo last week — the team appreciated the performance numbers. As a next step our security and compliance teams would like a focused architecture review covering:
- Where logs (audit/event) are generated, retained, and exported (SIEM hooks)
- KMS/HSM and key management options for customer keys
- SSO/SAML flow and SCIM provisioning behavior
- SOC 2 evidence mapping (where artifacts live, retention)
- Network segmentation and data residency controls for Private deployments

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with your infra/security engineer and product security lead? Preferably sometime this or next week. Attached a short list of initial questions.

Attendees from our side: Olivia Park (security lead), security@finserv.com (team mailbox), procurement@finserv.com may join depending on licensing questions.

Thanks,

Head of Security — FinServ Financial

- Thu Mar 12, 10:00–11:15 PT

If neither works, share a few options and we'll accommodate. I'll bring David Kim (infra/serving runtime) and loop in Marissa for SOC 2 evidence mapping and Stephanie for deployment controls & private VPC details.
